ALLIENT INC is a public company headquartered in Williamsville, New York, and trades under the ticker ALNT. It is registered with the SEC under CIK 0000046129. The company's website, alantra.com, describes Alantra as an international financial services firm with over 500 professionals across EMEA, the Americas, and Asia. According to the site, it provides investment banking and alternative asset management services to corporations, family-owned companies, and institutional investors, and operates under a listed partnership model in which teams work within corporate governance structures while retaining autonomy.

The harvested site text does not describe any AI products or AI-related services, and no products are tracked for the company. The held facts record no lawsuits and no MCP servers. The only additional held fact is a law exposure entry for New York, with a count of 459.
